Job Description & Summary
The Opportunity
As a Software Engineer - Senior Associate, you will engage in the development and innovation of software products within our Software and Product Innovation group. Your role will involve working directly with clients to deliver tailored software engineering solutions that meet their unique needs. As a Senior Associate, you will leverage your problem-solving skills and critical thinking to analyze complex problems and manage workstreams effectively. You will also focus on building meaningful client relationships and developing a deeper understanding of the business context, while mentoring Associates and junior team members.
In this role, you will be part of our Cloud Engineering, Data & Analytics network, contributing to the Digital Integration & Architecture go-to-market strategy. Within our Product Innovation competency, you will navigate complex situations, enhancing your personal brand and technical skills. You will be expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, delivering quality solutions while embracing increased ambiguity. This position offers a dynamic environment where you can grow professionally and make a significant impact on client engagements.
Responsibilities
- Developing and implementing software solutions using programming languages such as Java, Python, and JavaScript
- Collaborating with cross-functional teams to design and build scalable applications and microservices
- Conducting code reviews and adhering to coding standards to maintain quality software development
- Utilizing Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) practices to streamline software deployment processes
- Engaging in business requirements analysis to translate functional requirements into technical specifications
- Applying object-oriented design principles to create robust and maintainable software architectures
- Managing software testing and troubleshooting to identify and resolve issues efficiently
- Leveraging AI fluency and AI-human collaboration to enhance software capabilities and user experiences
- Participating in acceptance test-driven development (ATDD) to validate software functionality and performance
- Supporting digital integration and architecture initiatives to drive business process improvement and innovation
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 2 years of experience
What Sets You Apart
- Demonstrating AI fluency and AI-human collaboration
- Utilizing Acceptance Test Driven Development (ATDD) methodologies
- Excelling in API management and application development
- Proficient in Java, Python, and JavaScript programming languages
- Implementing microservices and enterprise application architecture
- Managing continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) processes
- Developing solutions with Mendix App Platform and React Native
Travel Requirements
Up to 80%
Job Posting End Date
The salary range for this position is: $77,000 - $202,000. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent upon the individual's skills, experience, qualifications and location, and applicable employment laws. All hired individuals are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. PwC offers a wide range of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, 401k, holiday pay, vacation, personal and family sick leave, and more. Job Description & Summary
The Opportunity
Manager, Data and Analytics Engineering, PricewaterhouseCoopers Advisory Services LLC, Seattle, WA.
Responsibilities
Design and build scalable data infrastructure and systems to support reliable and efficient data processing, integration, and analysis. Develop and implement end-to-end data pipelines, leveraging modern technologies and tools. Perform data transformation, validation, and quality assurance to ensure accuracy and consistency. Support the development of technical solutions that align with client needs and business goals. Contribute to innovation by exploring emerging technologies and proposing practical applications. Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, assist in project delivery, and provide guidance to junior staff as needed. Establish and maintain client relationships and professional networks. Supervise and coach teams.
What You Must Have
Must have a Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent in Business Analytics, Engineering, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, or a related field plus 5 years of post-bachelor’s, progressive related work experience.
In the alternative, the employer will accept a Master’s degree or foreign equivalent in Business Analytics, Engineering, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, or a related field, plus 3 years of related work experience.
Must have at least one year of experience with each of the following:
Architecting Enterprise data pipelines and crafting code in Standard Query Language (SQL) and Python;
Developing and implementing Artificial Intelligence (AI) enhanced architectures, including Generative AI (GenAI) and agentic solutions by leveraging techniques such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, and prompt engineering to optimize Large Language Model (LLM) outputs;
Architecting, deploying, and managing scalable Cloud-based data solutions using Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft (MS) Azure, and the Google Cloud Platform (GCP); and
Engaging with the Systems Development Lifecycles (SDLCs) such as Agile and Scrum methodologies and Application Programming Interface (API) based data acquisition and management.
This is a full time position. 50% telecommuting permitted. Must be able to commute to the designated local office.
Travel requirement(s): Domestic and/or international travel up to 80% required .
